newsitem.title: UK: BOE allots 282 mln stg in outright bills, repo.
newsitem.headline: BOE allots 282 mln stg in outright bills, repo.

text.p: The Bank of England said that it provided the UK money market with 282 million stg of assistance in afternoon operations.
It allotted 188 million stg in bills outright and 94 million stg in repos to May 7, 8 and 9.
It provided a total of 2.025 billion stg of liquidity to the market during the session for a forecast shortage of 2.0 billion stg. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7715
